Sidebar Alert CSS
format:
<style>
/* Alert mode: red sidebar and toolbar */
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-sidenav.alert-active {
    background-color: #ffcccc !important;
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-sidenav.alert-active md-list-item {
    color: #a00 !important;
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-toolbar.alert-active,
md-toolbar#toolbar.alert-active {
    background-color: #ca3838 !important;
}
/* Make sure icons etc visible */
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-sidenav.alert-active .md-button {
    color: #a00 !important;
}
</style>
<script>
(function(scope) {
    scope.$watch('msg.payload', function(v) {
        if (typeof v === 'undefined') return;
        var sidenav = document.querySelector('md-sidenav');
        var toolbar = document.querySelector('md-toolbar') || document.querySelector('#toolbar');
        if (v) {
            // alert on
            if (sidenav) {
                sidenav.classList.add('alert-active');
                sidenav.style.backgroundColor = '#ffcccc';
            }
            if (toolbar) {
                toolbar.classList.add('alert-active');
                toolbar.style.backgroundColor = '#ca3838';
            }
        } else {
            // normal
            if (sidenav) {
                sidenav.classList.remove('alert-active');
                sidenav.style.backgroundColor = '';
            }
            if (toolbar) {
                toolbar.classList.remove('alert-active');
                toolbar.style.backgroundColor = '';
            }
        }
    });
})(scope);
</script>
